note: The sentence lives here; the scorer emits only the stable finding_code and the measured/threshold variables. Authoring rule R-6: no number appears in a template except as a scorer-supplied variable. Style rules: UXS-MBPT-001 section 11 — name the step, then the consequence; second person; same finding, same wording, every time.

templates.MARK_WITHIN_TOLERANCE: Your mark was within {threshold} mmHg of the reference.
templates.MARK_OUT_OF_TOLERANCE: Your mark was {measured} mmHg from the reference, outside the {threshold} mmHg tolerance.
templates.MARK_ABSENT: No mark was recorded for this value during the descent.
templates.TRACKING_GAP_IN_MARKING_WINDOW: The dial was not being tracked at the moment you marked, so this value cannot be scored fairly. It is flagged, not failed.
templates.RATE_CONTROLLED: Your deflation stayed inside the band for the full descent.
templates.RATE_EXCURSION_PRESENT: Your deflation reached {measured} mmHg per second, above the {threshold} limit, during the descent. Sounds heard during a fast descent are read late, which pushes systolic high.
templates.RATE_MEAN_OUT_OF_BAND: Your average deflation rate was {measured} mmHg per second, outside the band. A slow descent congests the arm; a fast one skips sounds.
templates.INFLATION_ADEQUATE: You inflated to {measured} mmHg, above the required {threshold} mmHg.
templates.INFLATION_INADEQUATE: You inflated to {measured} mmHg, below the required {threshold} mmHg. Underinflation risks starting below a gap and reading systolic falsely low.
templates.NO_PARTIAL_REINFLATION: You deflated fully before any repeat inflation.
templates.REINFLATED_ON_PARTIAL_CUFF: You re-inflated on a partly deflated cuff. This congests the arm and distorts the sounds; deflate fully and pause before repeating.
templates.EXCURSION_CORRECTED_IN_ATTEMPT: Your rate went out of band and you brought it back without restarting. That correction is the skill.
templates.EXCURSION_NOT_CORRECTED: Your rate went out of band and did not come back before the end of the descent.
templates.PALPATION_AGREES: Your palpated estimate was within {threshold} mmHg of the auscultated systolic.
templates.PALPATION_DISAGREES: Your palpated estimate differed from the auscultated systolic by {measured} mmHg, more than the {threshold} mmHg expected.
templates.CIRCUMFERENCE_WITHIN_TOLERANCE: Your circumference measurement was within {threshold} cm of the reference.
templates.CIRCUMFERENCE_OUT_OF_TOLERANCE: Your circumference measurement differed from the reference by {measured} cm, outside the {threshold} cm tolerance. Check the tape sits at the midpoint between acromion and olecranon, snug but not compressing.
templates.CUFF_CORRECT: The cuff you selected is correct for the measured circumference.
templates.CUFF_INCORRECT: The cuff you selected does not match the measured circumference. A mis-sized cuff biases the reading in a known direction.
templates.GATE_DECISION_INCORRECT: One or more safety decisions were incorrect. A contraindicated limb is never used carefully; it is not used.
templates.ALTERNATIVE_STATED: You recognised that no available cuff fit and stated the correct alternative.
templates.PROCEEDED_WITHOUT_FIT: You proceeded without a fitting cuff. The correct action is to state the alternative, not to proceed.
templates.REST_INTERVAL_MET: The rest interval was observed in full.
templates.REST_INTERVAL_SHORT: Rest lasted {measured} seconds of the required {threshold}. Skipping rest raises the reading.
templates.RESPONSE_MATCHED: Your answer named what it needed to name.
templates.RESPONSE_CONCEPTS_MISSING: Your answer did not name everything required. Your words were recorded and will be reviewed.
templates.RESPONSE_PROMPTED: You gave the right answer only after being prompted. The standard is stating it unprompted.
templates.EXPLANATION_RECORDED: You explained the procedure before touching the limb. Recorded as completeness only; wording is not graded.
templates.EXPLANATION_ABSENT: No explanation to the patient was recorded before first limb contact.
templates.A7_SELF_REPORT_ONLY: Hand hygiene recorded, self reported. This is never reported as a measured competency.
templates.SELECTION_WITH_JUSTIFICATION: Your next practice choice and reasoning were recorded.
templates.SURFACE_NOT_CAPABLE: This objective needs spatial tracking that a phone cannot provide. It was not assessed, and this report says so.
templates.CONFIG_DECISION_PENDING_CUFF_STANDARD: Cuff selection cannot be scored until the cuff bladder fit standard is confirmed in writing with the partner institution.
templates.TREND_SCOPED: This objective is measured across attempts, not within one. See your trends.
templates.RELEASE_2_CASE_UNAVAILABLE: This objective needs a clinical case that is not yet in the library.
templates.NO_RESPONSE_CAPTURED: No response was captured for this objective.
templates.RESPONSE_SET_MISSING: The expected response set for this prompt is not available at the version this attempt used.
templates.NO_GROUND_TRUTH: No reference values are available for this attempt.
templates.NO_PRESSURE_TRACE: No pressure trace was captured for this attempt.
templates.NO_TIMER_EVENT: The rest timer did not run during this attempt.
templates.NO_GATE_RESPONSES: No safety gate decisions were captured for this objective.
templates.NO_EXCURSION_OCCURRED: Your rate never left the band, so detection and correction could not be exercised this attempt.
templates.NO_INFLATION_BASELINE: No palpated estimate was captured, so inflation adequacy could not be assessed.
templates.PALPATED_ESTIMATE_NOT_CAPTURED: No palpated estimate was captured during this attempt.
templates.CIRCUMFERENCE_NOT_CAPTURED: No circumference measurement was captured during this attempt.
templates.CUFF_SELECTION_NOT_CAPTURED: No cuff selection was captured during this attempt.
templates.OBJECTIVE_UNKNOWN: This objective is not recognised by this scorer version.
